verdict.rationale: Retell's API reference is generated from an internal OpenAPI document ("openapi-final"), but probes found it is not served at any public URL. Every candidate spec path returns 404, llms.txt lists no spec, and the SDKs ship no spec file. The interactive playground, typed SDKs, CLI and MCP server are adjacent features, not a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
